purpose: Bounded numerical-only shape diagnosis of the retained 3B protocol failure; no production inference or gate relaxation.
negative_control: Reproduce the exact original ten-context cached32 and uncached32 batches.
candidate_eligibility: All global reference gates and candidate-vs-reference raw-logit/probability/action-and-candidate-argmax checks must pass. Candidate failures remain findings.
path_selection: Fastest measured compatible candidate by one complete twenty-context pass; lexical name breaks exact timing ties. Exploratory, not production approval.
limits: Twenty contexts were deliberately chosen for numerical diagnosis, not representativeness.
Candidate batch replay and batch permutation must be reviewed and validated separately before any production recovery.
No change to original failed status or tolerance.
Single-reference fallback requires a separately reviewed protocol if no batched candidate is compatible.
